method.protocol: static BFGS relaxation (fmax 0.01 eV/A); Cu(111) slab at MACE lattice constant a=3.626 A, 4 layers (bottom 2 fixed), 10 A vacuum each side; p(4x4) cell = 1/16 ML O; sites fcc/hcp/top/bridge tested; E_ads = E(slab+O) - E(slab) - E(O atom, isolated, MACE)

payload.note: Most stable site: fcc hollow, -4.440 eV (p4x4, 1/16 ML). hcp -4.427, top -2.537; bridge relaxed to fcc. Convergence: p3x3 4L -4.436, p3x3 5L -4.437, p2x2 (0.25 ML) -4.428, so size and coverage effects are under 0.02 eV. fcc is preferred over hcp by only 0.013 eV, which is smaller than the model error; treat the two hollow sites as nearly degenerate. O height above the surface is 1.11 A. Referenced to 1/2 O2 (MACE): -1.677 eV. VALIDATION: (1) Cu lattice constant 3.626 A vs 3.615 A experimental (+0.3%). (2) O2 bond length 1.237 A vs 1.208 A experimental. MACE O2 De is 5.53 eV vs about 5.21 eV experimental (D0 5.12 eV + ZPE), so the model overbinds O2 by about 0.32 eV (0.16 eV per O); this tests the isolated-atom reference. (3) Independent DFT result: Xu & Mavrikakis, Surf. Sci. 494 (2001) 131 (PW91, abstract) give about -4.3 eV vs gas-phase O at the 3-fold hollow; our matching 0.25 ML value is -4.43 eV, which agrees within 0.13 eV. Other DFT reports range up to about -5.0 eV depending on functional and setup. UNCERTAINTY (+/-0.25 eV) covers the isolated-O reference error, the MACE-vs-DFT spread (-4.3 eV PW91 lit.), and size and coverage effects (<0.02 eV). It does not cover the PBE functional error itself. If the experimental O2 De replaces the MACE atom reference, E_ads = -1.677 - 5.21/2 = -4.28 eV, a lower bound on the binding strength. CAVEATS: MACE's isolated-atom energy is its fitted E0 term rather than a spin-polarized DFT atom calculation. This is a 0 K electronic adsorption energy with no ZPE. No direct experimental value was used.

_fulfilled_need.query: Compute the adsorption energy of atomic oxygen on Cu(111) at its most stable site, referenced to an isolated O atom.

summary: Cu adsorption_energy = -4.44 eV via ASE 3.29 + mace-torch 0.3.15 (GPU, float64)/MACE-MP-0 medium (2023-12-03-mace-128-L1_epoch-199) static BFGS relaxation (fmax 0.01 eV/A); Cu(111) slab at MACE lattice constant a=3.626 A, 4 layers (bottom 2 fixed), 10 A vacuum each side; p(4x4) cell = 1/16 ML O; sites fcc/hcp/top/bridge tested; E_ads = E(slab+O) - E(slab) - E(O atom, isolated, MACE)
